input.quote: e. Access. Client will have access to Interface usage statistics and raw log files in real time via the Interface.
input.rationale: The agreement grants TrueLink no audit, inspection, records-examination or usage-verification right against Client. Section 8 (Client covenants and warranties) contains no inspection or records right; Section 5/6 (Compensation; Documentation and Disputes) runs the other way, entitling Client to supporting documentation and to contest charges; and Section 3(e) puts usage statistics and raw log files in Client's hands rather than creating a TrueLink verification right. No provision gives TrueLink access to Client systems, premises or records for verification purposes (the only access reference, in the Section 9 Y2K warranty, is Client-requested remediation access at TrueLink's cost, which benefits us). With no audit right binding Client, there is no frequency, notice or cost-allocation exposure to constrain, so the position is better than both the preferred and fallback checklists and nothing should be redlined; volunteering an audit clause would only create a right TrueLink does not currently have.
